body: `agx sessions move` refuses when the same conversation uuid already exists in the target home ('... already exists in the target account'); it has no overwrite/merge mode. This happens when a conversation was resumed on both accounts and diverged (2026-09-30: copies shared the first ~7k lines, then each continued). Resolve by hand: compare with cmp, last-line timestamps and jq -r .uuid overlap, ask the owner which copy wins, move the losing copy's projects/<key>/<uuid>.jsonl and session-env/<uuid> into a backup folder, then run the normal move. Feature idea, not built: a conflict mode (keep newer / keep both).
